outcome_evidence: The oven door is initially lowered and open (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot approaches the door, then raises it toward the oven front (frames 49–67, image and left_ego_image). The door reaches the upright closed position by frame 72 and remains closed as the robot withdraws and through frame 138 (left_ego_image; supported by image). No failed attempt or unintended disturbance of surrounding objects is visible.
